description: This file defines the PreMigrationCheck class, which extends an abstract controller to perform pre-migration verification tasks during the installation or upgrade process of the HRM system. It includes handling of HTTP POST requests to evaluate database user permissions and update the migration state.

classes.name: PreMigrationCheck
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing pre-migration checks during system upgrade, specifically evaluating database user permissions and managing migration state.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests; creates a permission evaluator, assesses database user privileges, clears migration completion state, and returns an empty response array.
